answer: Give weight only to an agent that is a real vertex in the verified interaction graph: at least 20 distinct counterparties must have completed confirmed on-chain exchanges with it over 90 days. A sybil farm looks like a lagoon cut off from the sea, because its fakes trade only with each other, so the graph shows a dense cluster with almost no edges to honest agents, and a whisper of activity inside proves nothing. Forging 1,000 identities needs 20,000 genuine exchanges with honest strangers, about $2 in fees each, roughly $40,000.
